newsitem.title: USA: Penn Octane sees Q1 results below year ago.
newsitem.headline: Penn Octane sees Q1 results below year ago.

text.p: Penn Octane Corp said on Thursday its fiscal first quarter results would be signficantly below those of the same quarter last year, due to extended contract renewal negotiations with a unit of Petroleos Mexicanos.
But the company said in a statement it expects improved second quarter results.

Penn Octane said its annual agreement providing for the sale of liquid petroleum gas to PEMEX unit P.M.I. Trading LTD had been renewed for 12 months effective October 1. The agreement had expired on July 31, it said.
Under the agreement, annual volume commitments increased 10 percent over the prior agreement to a minimum 66 million gallons of liquid petroleum gas.
